digest.component_or_area: code-review gate, LLM runner, model resolution
propositions: Code-review gate declares per-step model classes on five LLM steps but ignores them at runtime, executing every call on the single cfg.model instead
PydanticAIRunner.run discards req.config.model and resolves from its constructor-time self._config, dropping per-step declarations one layer below where they are computed

Usage logging cannot attribute calls to steps because it records prompt name (op) not step id, and code-review-base is used by both base step and batch finder, making attribution ambiguous without step context
Per-step model declarations are computed correctly by RunnerAgentStep.resolve_model and CodeReviewBatchRunner but never consulted by the runner that receives them
The same root cause breaks four plan-review sub-calls and the prerequisite escalation ladder, making per-call config overrides silently ineffective across all workflows
